adds.title: Mongolian Penal Code, Section 14.1.1
adds.summary: Mongolia's revised Criminal Law of 3 December 2015, Article 1.3.2, prohibits discrimination in criminalization and sentencing on grounds including sexual and gender orientation.

adds.title: Mongolian Criminal Code, Section 10(1)(2)(14) - New Criminal Code adopted 3 December 2015
adds.summary: Mongolia's revised Criminal Code adopted 3 December 2015 provides in Article 1.3(2) that defining crimes and imposing punishment shall not discriminate on grounds including sexual and gender orientation.
